newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks suffer biggest drop in a month.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks suffer biggest drop in a month.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks suffered their biggest loss in a month Wednesday amid Wall Street's frustration at the inability of the Dow Jones industrial average to hold rallies above 6,000 points.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended 36.15 points lower at 5,930.62. The index bolted several times this week through 6,000 points but ended below that milestone.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances 14-8 on moderate volume of 409 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
